What is a fancy text generator?

A fancy text generator swaps ordinary letters for look-alike Unicode characters: mathematical bold and script letters, circled and squared letters, small capitals, and combining marks such as underlines and glitch effects. Because the result is text rather than a font file, you can paste it wherever plain text is accepted: an Instagram or TikTok bio, a Discord display name, a YouTube comment, or a game chat that supports Unicode.

Popular styles

Bold text and italic text are the most widely supported. Cursive script and gothic blackletter add personality to a name. Bubble letters, tiny text and glitch text make playful accents. Want a mix? The style mixer layers a style, an effect and a symbol frame.

Fonts for your favorite app

See what works in each app, including character limits: Instagram fonts, TikTok fonts, Discord fonts, X (Twitter) fonts and Facebook fonts.

Will this text work on Instagram, TikTok and Discord?

Usually, in bios, captions, posts, comments and display names, because the result is ordinary Unicode text rather than a font. Usernames and handles normally allow only basic letters, numbers, periods and underscores, so styled letters are rejected there. Paste once and check the preview in the app before saving.

Why do some letters show as boxes or question marks?

The device viewing your text has no font containing that character. Newer phones rarely have this problem with the common styles, but older systems and some games do. Choose a widely supported style such as bold or italic when reach matters.

Can screen readers read fancy text?

Not reliably. Many screen readers announce each styled letter by its Unicode name or skip it, so a styled phrase can become hard to follow. Style a short accent, and keep important words, links and instructions in ordinary letters.

Is CopySprig free?

Yes. Every style and symbol is free, with no signup. Your text is transformed in your browser and never uploaded.

A note on the characters

CopySprig converts basic Latin letters into selected Unicode alphabets. Lettering and combining-effect styles preserve punctuation, whitespace, emoji, accented letters and other writing systems. Some styles also support digits; incomplete alphabets leave unsupported letters as they are. Playful styles may change case, add spaces or reverse whole graphemes within each line. Upside-down text substitutes selected lowercase Latin letters while preserving the shapes of other characters. Each result includes a short coverage note.

Why does the text look different after I paste it?

The destination chooses the font and rendering. A missing character may appear as a box, and some fields reject decorative Unicode. Try a simpler style or use plain text recovery.

Does CopySprig store the words I type?

The tool runs in your browser. Your entered text is not uploaded or included in analytics. Saved and recent selections store style, mix or symbol identifiers on this device, rather than your custom phrases.

Can I use these as fonts in a document?

This generates characters you can paste. It does not install or download a typeface. Native bold and italic formatting is preferable when the destination supports it.

Help improve CopySprig?

Optional analytics counts page visits and actions such as copying a style. It never receives the words you type or the text you copy. The tools work either way. Privacy details
